chapters.title: 1. The Boat
chapters.text:
My name is Nell and I am fourteen years old. I live on a small island in the north. There are nine houses on the island, one shop and one very old lighthouse. People call it the Blackrock Light.

Every Friday a boat comes from the town. It brings bread, letters and sometimes a visitor. Visitors are rare here, so everybody watches the boat.

That Friday the boat was late. My grandmother stood at the window and looked at the grey water for a long time.

'Something is wrong,' she said quietly.

'The weather is bad, that's all,' I answered. But I did not believe my own words. The wind was strong and the sea was white near the rocks.

At six o'clock we saw a small light far away. It moved slowly, then it stopped. Then it went out.

My grandmother put on her coat. 'Come,' she said. 'We must go down to the beach.'

chapters.title: 2. The Visitor
chapters.text:
We ran down the wet path to the beach. The rain was cold on my face. Near the water we found a man. He was sitting on a stone and holding his arm.

'Are you hurt?' my grandmother asked.

'A little,' he said. 'My boat hit the rocks. I must get to the lighthouse tonight.'

'Nobody goes to the lighthouse,' I told him. 'It is empty. It has been empty for twenty years.'

The man looked at me and smiled. It was a strange, tired smile.

'It is not empty,' he said. 'I lived there once, when I was a boy. And I left something behind me.'

My grandmother said nothing, but her face changed. She knew this man. I was sure of it.

We walked back to the house together. Nobody spoke. Behind us, high on the black rocks, the old lighthouse stood dark against the sky.
